Home/Our Story

Born on an estate, raised in the city.

Why does India's best coffee rarely reach an Indian cup? We set out to change that.

Meet the founder

“I spent years writing code. Then I went looking for the perfect cup, and found it in India's own hills.”

An IT professional whose daily coffee became an obsession.

He travelled India's coffee regions, from Coorg to Araku, to find the best beans at the source.

First Sip blends a coffee house's warmth with a tech company's precision.

IT professional turned founder6 coffee regions explored100% Indian beans
Varun Velicheti
Founder & CEO, First Sip
Our journey

From a home kitchen to a national brand.

2019

Varun starts home-roasting beans from across India.

2021

Six coffee regions. Countless farms. One mission.

2022

Direct-trade network

40 partner farms, paid above market price.

2024

First café opens in Bandra

Our Bandra flagship opens its doors.

2025

Bengaluru, Delhi and online

Bengaluru, Delhi and online, across India.

2026

Building the national roadmap

150 cafés by 2030. Become a partner →
